sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: Live verified-TLS Liberia Immigration Service application portal expressly makes use of VOA depend on the existence of a Liberian embassy in the applicant's country.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The same current LIS portal distinguishes a PDF confirmation from final physical visa issuance after arrival, biometric collection and officer processing at Roberts International Airport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once completed, you will receive a visa sticker in your passport.

sources.title: Service Delivery Charter
sources.officialityEvidence: Live LIS January 2025 Service Delivery Charter states its 2024–2029 operating period. Its VOA service covers named broad groups but preserves a separate, unpublished eligibility test, host letter and seven-working-day processing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens from Countries who meet the eligibility criteria to enter Liberia.

sources.title: Discover Liberia: Entry & visas
sources.officialityEvidence: Live official tourism guidance uses generic eVisa language but says only 'most visitors' and directs confirmation. It is neither a nationality schedule nor evidence of electronic final visa issuance against LIS's current airport-sticker workflow.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Most visitors — including US, UK, EU, Canadian and Australian passport holders — need a visa before boarding.
